name: Graphic Packaging International
old_description: Our next generation packaging solutions create memorable moments now
about:
Graphic Packaging International is headquartered in West Monroe, Louisiana. The company operates as part of Graphic Packaging Holding Company, a publicly traded corporation. Public materials do not disclose a founding year or founder names.

The company manufactures consumer packaging solutions with a focus on paperboard. Its product portfolio includes proprietary systems such as CleanClose™ child-resistant detergent packaging, Boardio™ rigid paperboard canisters, KeelClip™ clip-style multipack cartons that replace plastic rings, PaperSeal™ barrier-lined trays for modified-atmosphere applications, and ProducePack™ recyclable punnet trays for fresh produce. Graphic Packaging runs a global network of more than 100 paperboard manufacturing facilities, packaging plants, design and innovation centers, and regional offices, employing over 23,000 people and holding roughly 3,000 patents.

Customers span foodservice, pet care, e-commerce, beverage, household detergents, and fresh produce. The company cites collaborations with brands such as BETTERGUARDS for sports-technology packaging and Smithy Mushrooms for exotic mushroom punnets. Its packaging also serves detergent pods, beverage multipacks, and modified-atmosphere food trays.

Graphic Packaging positions itself as a leader in sustainable consumer packaging, emphasizing renewable, recycled, and recyclable materials. It promotes a Design for the Environment approach and highlights innovations that replace plastic with paperboard alternatives, aiming to reduce environmental impact while maintaining performance.
